# jamfplatform_pro_app_installer_settings (Data Source)

Read the current Jamf Pro App Installer global settings. Singleton — one record per tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jamfplatform_pro_app_installer_settings" "current" {}

output "deployment_batch_size" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_app_installer_settings.current.deployment_settings != null ? data.jamfplatform_pro_app_installer_settings.current.deployment_settings.batch_size : null
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `deployment_settings` (Attributes) Deployment batch process controls. Null when not configured. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployment_settings))
- `end_user_experience` (Attributes) End-user notification and deferral settings. Null when not configured. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--end_user_experience))
- `id` (String) Fixed singleton identifier. Always `singleton`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--deployment_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployment_settings`

Read-Only:

- `batch_frequency` (Number) Minutes between batch deployments.
- `batch_size` (Number) Number of devices per command batch.
- `days` (Set of String) Days of the week on which deployments run.
- `server_time_from` (String) Start of the daily deployment window. Format: `HH:MM:SSZ`.
- `server_time_to` (String) End of the daily deployment window. Format: `HH:MM:SSZ`.


<a id="nestedatt--end_user_experience"></a>
### Nested Schema for `end_user_experience`

Read-Only:

- `force_quit_grace_period` (Number) Minutes the user is given to quit the app before the install proceeds.
- `force_quit_message` (String) Message shown when the user is prompted to quit the app.
- `notification_frequency` (Number) Hours between repeat notifications.
- `notification_message` (String) Message shown when the notification first appears.
- `relaunch` (Boolean) Whether the app is relaunched automatically after update.
- `suppress` (Boolean) Whether notifications are suppressed.
- `update_complete_message` (String) Message shown when the installation completes.
- `update_deadline` (Number) Hours the user may defer before the install is forced.
